data.one_liner: Cross-platform Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) plugin for Flutter
data.what_it_does: A cross-platform plugin enabling Flutter apps to act as BLE clients or peripherals across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web. It supports scanning, connecting, discovering services, reading/writing data, pairing, and managing BLE availability.
use_when: You need to build a Flutter application that interacts with BLE peripherals across mobile, desktop, and web.
Your app needs to act as a peripheral device as well as a client.
You require detailed scan filters, MTU requests, RSSI reading, and connection state streams.
avoid_when: You only need Bluetooth Classic instead of Low Energy.
You do not want to handle platform-specific permissions and Bluetooth setup.
strengths: Supports all major platforms including Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web.
Provides both client mode and peripheral mode APIs.
Rich scanning filters with service data, manufacturer data, and name prefixes.
weaknesses: Some advanced features have platform-specific limitations or lack support on specific targets (e.g. Web Bluetooth limitations).
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific permission setup for Bluetooth on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web.
